method: Audit whole loaded byte cohorts against 228 unpruned source collections. A return-padding counterclaim retains identical CRC spans and checksums and requires a visible return and padding. Existing required clauses can be reduced only with their own complete unpruned witness and an independently distinguishing image import or RTTI site; complete incoming source declarations remain separate. Call-only clauses retain every original reference because a callee name may itself be an ambiguous byte claim. Evaluation labels and addresses never select rules.
limits: Preferred candidates are suggestions, not independently admitted source identities.
The source matrix and 60 linked probes are bounded evidence, not exhaustive compiler/ABI coverage or a comparison proving superiority to another product.
Stricter contradictory evidence can withdraw formerly correct suggestions; losses and gains are reported separately.
Three original nominal identities remain ambiguous under the available bytes and references; no aliases or names are invented.
The optional external-format roundtrip could not be qualified: the installed dumper does not support the required full-record -F export. Hosted CI results are separate from the retained local checks.

data_tools.skip_reason: Optional external-format roundtrip requires a compatible full-record dumper.

remaining_identity_audit.finding: _time64 and common_time<_J> have identical complete bytes and references in distinct source sections. The two heap getters and select_heap have identical instructions and the same data reference, with only INT3 padding differences. No export or COFF names or relocated absolute pointer independently binds these names in the held-out executable. This does not prove the absence of all computed indirect references or future metadata.

performance.scope: Coherent Release baseline and candidate signature owners built against the same current headers and dependencies; twelve VS2022 PE probes across x86, x64, ARM and ARM64, ordinary/MFC/debug. Unrelated host work may affect wall-clock measurements; alternating same-engine controls quantify run noise. No competitor or universal-best-performance claim. Warm matching measures apply plus candidate-name-map construction on identical entry lists; parsing/loading is outside warm timing. Fresh processes include loading/matching with OS page cache and signature disk cache retained.
